review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 2:40 AM ET. It had Kashiwa 52%, the draw 21% and Newcastle Jets 27%, projecting Kashiwa 2.3 – Newcastle Jets 1.6 (3.9 total, Kashiwa by 0.7).

Final: Kashiwa 2 – Newcastle Jets 1. Right winner: it had Kashiwa at 52%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Kashiwa came in with a 19% above average attack and a 21% stingier than average defense (2-1-1, 2 scored and 0.8 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 23 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.3, they scored 2 (−0.3 goals, 12% under); projected to allow 1.6, they allowed 1 (−0.6 goals, 38% under).

Newcastle Jets came in with a 21% above average attack and a 32% leakier than average defense (0-0-4, 1.5 scored and 4.8 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 22 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.6, they scored 1 (−0.6 goals, 38% under); projected to allow 2.3, they allowed 2 (−0.3 goals, 12% under).

The bigger miss was Newcastle Jets' scoring (-0.6 goals against projection).
